mcqs.question: The October 2025 news item titled “UN at 80 — reviving multilateralism” referred to which development?
options: The 80th anniversary of the United Nations and the 80th UNGA
Shashi Tharoor’s argument that multilateralism is “wounded, not dead”
The constraints created by the UNSC veto and weak enforcement
The post-World War II structure of the United Nations
mcqs.explanation: The news item marked the 80th anniversary of the United Nations and the 80th UNGA. Shashi Tharoor’s statement on multilateralism being “wounded, not dead” was an argument associated with the issue, not the headline event itself.
